i-m-hong-ruei.zh: 我是<mark class="kw">吳弘叡</mark>，土生土長的臺中霧峰人。
i-m-hong-ruei.en: I'm <mark class="kw">Hong-Ruei Wu</mark>, born and raised in Wufeng, Taichung.

i-love-playing-volleyball.zh: 興趣是打<mark class="kw">排球</mark>，曾任本校應用數學系排球隊<mark class="kw">隊長</mark>。現於資工系排擔任小小隊員。
i-love-playing-volleyball.en: I love playing <mark class="kw">volleyball</mark> and previously served as <mark class="kw">captain</mark> of our Department of Applied Mathematics volleyball team. Now I'm just a humble member of the Computer Science volleyball team.
